Check Your Learning Convert a volume of 9.345 qt to liters. 2 Strictly speaking, the ounce and pound are units of weight, W (a force equal to the product of mass and gravitational acceleration, W = mg). The conversion relations in this table are commonly used to equate masses and weight assuming a nominal value for g at the surface of the earth.

Check Your Learning A Toyota Prius Hybrid uses 59.7 L gasoline to drive from San Francisco to Seattle, a distance of 1300 km (two significant digits). (a) What (average) fuel economy, in miles per gallon, did the Prius get during this trip? (b) If gasoline costs $3.90 per gallon, what was the fuel cost for this trip?
